environment.dataVolume: 500 documents (254 issue / 91 wiki / 35 sprint / 32 weekly_plan / 27 weekly_retro / 20 person / 15 weekly_review / 15 project / 6 standup / 5 program), 20 users
scaffolding: Lighthouse 11.7.1 via `npx --yes lighthouse@11` (not added to the repo); driven against Playwright's bundled Chromium 147 (chromium-1217) via CHROME_PATH — no system Chrome present.
axe-core scan via the repo's @axe-core/playwright 4.11.0 + @playwright/test 1.57.0 Chromium; tags wcag2a,wcag2aa,wcag21a,wcag21aa,best-practice.
Authenticated with a real session cookie (dev@ship.local); pages verified to render authenticated content (finalUrl not /login).

The seeded dev user has an overdue action item, so an 'Action Items' role=dialog auto-opens on every navigation; it was dismissed (Escape) before page/keyboard scans so measurements reflect the underlying page.
Runner scripts saved: audit/a11y/run-lighthouse.sh, audit/a11y/axe-scan.mjs; raw reports in audit/a11y/lighthouse/ and audit/a11y/axe/.

metrics.keyboardPerPage: issues: Full (45 stops, no focus trap, focus ring 45/45) · my-week: Full (20/20 stops, focus ring 42/44)
metrics.contrastWorstOffender: /my-week — text-[11px] text-muted/50 timestamps + bg-accent/20 badges below 4.5:1
metrics.note508: Deployed at ship.awsdev.treasury.gov — a federal (Treasury) app, so Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA conformance is effectively mandated; every Critical/Serious axe violation below contradicts that.

findings.title: Workspace-documents sidebar uses role="tree" but its children are plain <li> nav links, not treeitems (axe Critical + Serious)
findings.location: web/src — contextual sidebar 'Workspace documents' tree (rendered on every authenticated page); <ul role="tree" aria-label="Workspace documents" aria-live="polite">
findings.evidence: axe rule aria-required-children (Critical): `<ul role="tree" aria-label="Workspace documents" aria-live="polite">` — "Element has children which are not allowed: li[tabindex]". axe rule listitem (Serious): `<li><a href="/docs?filter=workspace">…` — "List item parent element has a role that is not role=\"list\"". Present on document view AND document-editor-focused states (audit/a11y/axe/document_view.json, document_editor_focused.json).
findings.hypothesis: The sidebar mixes ARIA-tree items (role=treeitem) with plain filter links (`All documents`, `Workspace`, …) as bare <li> children of the same role="tree" <ul>. role="tree" requires role="treeitem"/group children; the plain <li>s violate both the tree contract and the list contract.
findings.estimatedImpact: The primary navigation tree — on every page — is announced incorrectly by screen readers (item count/role wrong), a Section-508 blocker on a federal app. Fix: give every child treeitem semantics, or drop role="tree" for a plain list/nav. Cross-references A11Y-8 (both are semantic-markup defects).

findings.title: TipTap editor wrapper sets aria-expanded on a plain <div> with no supporting role (axe Critical)
findings.evidence: axe rule aria-allowed-attr (Critical): `<div style="position: relative;" aria-expanded="false">` — "ARIA attribute is not allowed: aria-expanded='false'". Appears whenever the editor is mounted/focused (audit/a11y/axe/document_editor_focused.json).
findings.hypothesis: A wrapper div (likely a floating/bubble-menu container) carries aria-expanded without a widget role (button/combobox/etc.) that permits it, so assistive tech gets a meaningless/expanded-collapsed cue on a non-interactive element.
findings.estimatedImpact: Confusing/invalid ARIA on the core editing surface used for every document type (508 contradiction). Fix: move aria-expanded onto the actual toggle control (with a supporting role) or remove it from the wrapper.

findings.title: Dashboard (/my-week) fails color contrast on 25 elements — muted 50%-opacity text and translucent badges (axe Serious; the only Lighthouse-failing page)
findings.evidence: axe color-contrast (Serious): 25 nodes on /my-week, e.g. `.text-[11px].text-muted/50.text-right` and `.bg-accent/20.py-0.5.px-1.5`. Corroborated by Lighthouse — /my-week is the ONLY key page below 100 (score 95) and color-contrast is its sole failing audit (audit/a11y/lighthouse/dashboard.report.json).
findings.hypothesis: Tailwind opacity modifiers (`text-muted/50`, `bg-accent/20`) at an 11px size drop foreground/background contrast below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
findings.estimatedImpact: Low-vision users can't read dashboard timestamps/labels; 508 contradiction on the landing page. This is the best improvement-target candidate: +≥10 Lighthouse pts on the lowest-scoring page is achievable by raising these opacities/colors. Fix: use full-opacity muted tokens meeting 4.5:1.

findings.title: A Radix popover/dropdown opens as a role=dialog with no accessible name (axe Serious)
findings.evidence: axe aria-dialog-name (Serious): `#radix-:rj:` dialog node has no accessible name (audit/a11y/axe/issues_menu_expanded_state.json). Triggered by opening a menu/popover on /issues.
findings.hypothesis: A Radix Dialog/Popover is rendered without aria-label / aria-labelledby (or a visually-hidden title), so screen readers announce an unnamed dialog.
findings.estimatedImpact: Screen-reader users hear 'dialog' with no context when the control opens (508 contradiction on a core list page). Fix: add an accessible name to the dialog/popover.

findings.title: /search and /weeks render with no <main> landmark and no level-one heading (axe Moderate)
findings.evidence: axe landmark-one-main + page-has-heading-one (both Moderate) fire on /search and /weeks (audit/a11y/axe/search.json, weeks_board.json). Corroborates the error-handling probe1b observation that /search and /weeks rendered near-empty (`<no #main-content>`, bodyTextLength 0).
findings.hypothesis: These two routes render content outside the shell's `<main id="main-content">` (or render an empty state before data), and neither provides an h1, so there is no main landmark or page heading for AT users to orient by.
findings.estimatedImpact: No landmark/heading structure to navigate two key pages (508). Fix: ensure every route renders inside the main landmark with an h1 (even in empty states).

findings.title: Document pages skip heading levels (h1 → h3), breaking the screen-reader outline (axe Moderate)
findings.location: web/src — document view (headings observed: h2, h1, h3 with no h2 under h1)
findings.evidence: axe heading-order (Moderate) on document view/editor states; a11y-tree probe recorded headings [2,1,3] with a single h1 (audit/a11y/axe/_summary.json tree).
findings.hypothesis: Section headings in the document chrome/content are chosen for size, not level, producing a non-monotonic outline (an h3 directly under the h1).
findings.estimatedImpact: Heading-based navigation lands users on mis-nested sections (Medium; 508). Fix: make heading levels increase by one.

findings.title: Login page: form content not contained in a landmark and no main landmark (axe Moderate) — missed by the repo's critical-only specs
findings.evidence: axe region + landmark-one-main (Moderate) on /login: 5 nodes (`.mb-8`, `form > div:nth-child(1..2)`, …) not contained by a landmark (audit/a11y/axe/login_unauth.json). Note: e2e/accessibility.spec.ts asserts login has 'no critical accessibility violations' — these are Moderate, so they pass that gate; this is exactly what the existing critical-only specs miss.
findings.hypothesis: The login route renders outside the app shell, so its form/content sits directly under <body> with no <main>/landmark wrapper.
findings.estimatedImpact: Minor orientation loss on the unauthenticated entry page (Low). Fix: wrap the login view in a main landmark.

findings.title: Issues table selection column has an empty table header (axe Minor)
findings.location: web/src issues table — `th[aria-label="Selection"]` with no cell text
findings.hypothesis: The checkbox/selection column header renders empty visible text; axe wants header text even though an aria-label is present.
findings.estimatedImpact: Minor screen-reader ambiguity on the issues table header row (Low). Fix: provide visually-hidden header text.
